conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose compactness of a closed family, compactness of a closure, relative compactness or total boundedness, existence of a uniformly convergent subsequence and continuity of its limit, or an equivalence characterization.
degenerate_case_status: No case is formally excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every boundary case listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: uniformly bounded equicontinuous real-valued continuous sequences on a compact metric domain have uniformly convergent subsequences
an equicontinuous family of bounded continuous functions with one common compact range has compact closure in the uniform topology
an equicontinuous family with pointwise relatively compact ranges has compact closure in the compact-open or uniform-on-compact topology
a closed family satisfying compact-range and equicontinuity hypotheses is compact
relative compactness is equivalent to equicontinuity plus an appropriate pointwise relative-compactness condition
excluded_substitutions: Dini, Stone-Weierstrass, Banach-Alaoglu, Rellich-Kondrachov, Aubin-Lions, Montel, Prokhorov, or Helly selection in place of Arzela-Ascoli
a finite family, finite domain, compact codomain alone, or constant-function special case
a structure or premise that already stores a convergent subsequence or compact closure
one pinned declaration selected solely from its Arzela-Ascoli name
the untrusted verified label, a source URL, or the intake API probe used as source, statement-identity, or proof credit
